text: Technical Product Partner (Part-Time) | AI Tools & Agency SaaS Builds. Verified, payment verified, 4.9 rating, $200K+ spent. United States. Fixed price. Expert. Est. budget: $1,500.00. About the Role: I run a small performance marketing company in Orange County, CA specializing in paid media and lead generation. Over the past year, I've been building a suite of internal and client-facing SaaS tools alongside my core agency work, and I need a partner to help me build faster. This is not a task-based freelance gig. I'm looking for someone who genuinely gets what I'm building, can absorb the vision quickly, and keeps things moving when I'm not around. Technical ability matters, but product thinking and execution speed matter more. A growing stack of marketing-adjacent SaaS products and internal tools, including: a little landing page platform to test AI landing pages (most urgent), an AI-powered ad audit and creative analysis tool, a multi-tenant client portal.
